info.description: Audit log of Talk2Us requests lodged by the Eli digital assistant (phone or web). Written by POST /api/assistant-requests/submit; never public.

channel.description: ElevenLabs channel, e.g. sip_trunk (phone) or widget.

conversationId.description: ElevenLabs conversation id — also the idempotency key.

category.description: Talk2Us Category — decides which department inbox Jotform notifies.

talk2usId.description: Talk2Us! ID (e.g. T2US-000810) read back to the member.
